step1_figure.circuit_type: 9-stage tapered CMOS inverter buffer driving large capacitive load
step1_figure.description: Figure 11.20 shows the 9-stage tapered inverter buffer designed in Example 11.8 to achieve minimum propagation delay when driving a large 20 pF load with an optimal tapering factor A = e (2.718).

t_phl.description: High-to-low output propagation delay (from 50% Vin rising to 50% Vout falling across all 9 stages)

equation.explanation: Sum of propagation delays through each stage of the 9-inverter chain when the output transitions from high to low.
equation.assumptions: Equal delay per stage with sizing factor A = e; 50% VDD threshold.

sky130_expected.calculation: With optimal sizing A = 2.718 and N = 9 stages, each stage has an intrinsic delay around 40-70 ps in Sky130 (1.8V). Total t_PHL = 9 * 55 ps ≈ 500 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sub-nanosecond propagation delay achieved through optimal exponential buffer sizing driving 20 pF.

t_plh.description: Low-to-high output propagation delay (from 50% Vin falling to 50% Vout rising across all 9 stages)

equation.explanation: Sum of propagation delays through each stage of the 9-inverter chain when the output transitions from low to high.
equation.assumptions: Equal delay per stage with PMOS sized twice NMOS to equalize drive strength.

sky130_expected.calculation: With Wp/Wn = 2:1 ratio maintained across all 9 stages, PMOS pull-up drive is balanced with NMOS pull-down drive, yielding t_PLH ≈ 500 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric inverter design yields comparable high-to-low and low-to-high delays.

t_prop_total.description: Total round-trip propagation delay sum (t_PHL + t_PLH)

equation.explanation: Calculates the total propagation delay for both switching transitions across all N cascaded buffer stages.
equation.assumptions: Geometric scaling factor A = 2.718 across N = 9 stages.

sky130_expected.calculation: (t_PHL + t_PLH) = 500 ps + 500 ps = 1.0 ns in Sky130.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct sum of t_PHL and t_PLH for the complete buffer.

stage_delay.description: Average propagation delay per stage per transition

source.reference: Page 346 text: t_PHL = t_PLH = (t_PHL + t_PLH)_{total} / (2 * N)

equation.explanation: Average delay contributed by an individual inverter stage within the tapered buffer.
equation.assumptions: Delay is distributed equally across all 9 stages.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Optimal stage delay for Sky130 inverters with fanout of e.

fall_time.description: Output 90% to 10% fall time driving 20 pF load

equation.explanation: Time for the final stage (stage 9) to discharge the 20 pF load from 90% to 10% of VDD.
equation.assumptions: Linear RC approximation of the final stage pull-down network.

sky130_expected.calculation: Stage 9 NMOS width Wn = 29780 * 0.15u ≈ 4467 um. Effective resistance R_n9 ≈ 0.15 ohm. t_fall ≈ 2.2 * 0.15 * 20 pF ≈ 6.6 ps without interconnect/parasitics, realistically 80-250 ps including internal charging.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Extremely large output stage provides fast discharge of 20 pF.

rise_time.description: Output 10% to 90% rise time driving 20 pF load

equation.explanation: Time for the final stage PMOS network to charge the 20 pF load from 10% to 90% of VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Stage 9 PMOS width Wp = 59570 * 0.15u ≈ 8935 um. Effective resistance R_p9 ≈ 0.25 ohm. Realistic rise time with input ramp ≈ 100-300 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large PMOS driver provides high charging current into 20 pF.

dynamic_power.description: Average dynamic power dissipation of the 9-stage buffer driving 20 pF at 143 MHz

equation.explanation: Dynamic power dissipated due to charging and discharging internal gate capacitances and the 20 pF load capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Square wave input with period T = 7 ns (fclk ≈ 143 MHz), VDD = 1.8 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: P_load = Cload * VDD^2 * fclk = 20e-12 * 1.8^2 * (1 / 7e-9) = 9.26 mW. Adding intermediate stage dynamic power (~6 mW), total P_avg ≈ 15-20 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the 20 pF load capacitance and large final stages.

power_delay_product.description: Power-delay product of the buffer driving 20 pF

equation.explanation: Product of average dynamic power and total propagation delay.
equation.assumptions: Calculated over one full input switching period.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard PDP calculation combining dynamic power and delay.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench for the 9-stage tapered inverter buffer driving a 20 pF load in Sky130, measuring t_PHL, t_PLH, total delay, per-stage delay, rise/fall times, average dynamic power, and PDP.
